images.alt:
Da Xia Shou Mu Ren Anime Overview:

Da Xia Shou Mu Ren is an action and supernatural ONA series adapted from a web novel. The story takes place in a modern world that undergoes a sudden and terrifying shift following an anomalous celestial event characterized by a persistent blood moon. Strange entities, ancient myths, and paranormal anomalies materialize across the globe, plunging humanity into widespread panic and existential peril. Amidst the chaos, a new class of extraordinary individuals emerges to combat the encroaching threats. The narrative follows a young man named Su Bai as he crosses the threshold into this hidden realm of the supernatural, navigating dangerous phenomena and uncovering the mysterious forces reshaping human society.

Japanese Title: 大夏守墓人

images.alt:
Yi Nian Yongheng 4 Anime Overview:

The fourth installment of the animated adaptation following Bai Xiaochun continues the comedic and supernatural cultivation journey of the resourceful protagonist. Set within a vast and perilous cultivation world filled with rival sects, ancient beasts, and formidable immortals, the narrative tracks Bai Xiaochun as he navigates high-stakes political maneuvers and mystical trials. Relying on his quick wits, unconventional techniques, and an uncanny knack for stumbling into dangerous situations, he seeks to increase his personal power while protecting his allies and preserving his own safety. This continuation deepens the overarching fantasy lore as the protagonist confronts advanced cultivation tiers, larger threats to his sect, and new challenges that test his adaptability and resolve in a realm where strength determines survival.

Japanese Title: 一念永恒 第四季
